processing: Project-authored manual annotations in a 512 × 512 GSI gazo1 tile mosaic: approximate roof outlines, an inferred plaza/street boundary, explicit proxy height assumptions, modern-feature replacement/exclusion hypotheses and provisional camera pixels. The registered 1975 plaza photograph corroborates the open-space/plaza interpretation and reversible modern-feature omission hypotheses; historic photo/catalogue URLs also support building identification research. No photograph pixels or textures are embedded, and the evidence citation grants no redistribution permission for the photograph.
units: native aerial mosaic pixels; height assumptions in metres
coordinate_system: GSI XYZ/Web Mercator tile indices, EPSG:3857; pixel coordinates in the 512 × 512 mosaic; not local metres.
inferred_elements: Project-authored interpretation of historical aerial imagery, with explicit roof/plaza annotations and assumed heights. Native pixels are not surveyed coordinates. The aerial period spans 1974–1978, its exact capture date is unknown, and historical building identity/entrance positions remain provisional. Modern feature IDs identify context to be replaced or excluded in the study; PLATEAU did not author this historical layout hypothesis.
redistribution_review: GSI gazo1 is listed under attribution-only non-basic-survey tiles; GSI PDL 1.0 permits CC BY 4.0 use, which is selected here. This artifact contains no redistributed archival photographs or raw aerial raster imagery. The 1975 plaza photograph is cited as evidence only; its redistribution permission and license remain unconfirmed.
